text_block_list.text:
During a break in team training,
Rice Shower had a sorrowful look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hearing everyone's sad stories made Rice...
sad too... *sniff*.

"Upon asking for more details, it seemed the team
members were getting hyped up during a break
sharing their recent misfortune stories――"

Rice Shower seemed to have been
affected by that "tale of misfortune."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Like someone who fell into a ditch...
while walking...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Like... a kid who had a nightmare
about being chased by a kaiju...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Like someone who... mixed up
the sugar and the salt while cooking...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hearing your story...
it just made me so sad...!

"Even so, everyone takes things differently.
The fact remains that Rice Shower is hurting."

I want to do whatever I can to cheer her up.
And so—
choice_data_list: Shall we think about what happens next in the story?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: The rest of... the story...?
choice_data_list: The Uma Musume who fell into the ditch, there—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……
choice_data_list: I managed to find what was lost.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's true...
This is the continuation of our story... isn't it?
"‘The Umamusume who was chased by a monster was eventually able to become friends with it.’"

"I mixed up the sugar and salt,
but the dish still turned out super delicious!"

As I continued doing that,
her expression gradually brightened up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I seeee... That's such a relief...
Everyone was happy in the end, wasn't that right...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fufu...♪

Rice Shower calmed down
and tackled her training with a smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that, <chrname> also seemed
to feel a sense of warmth in her heart.
